paper.title_en: Luttinger Liquid Behavior in a Single-Layer Nickelate La1.4Sr0.6NiO4
paper.abstract_en: The discovery of high-temperature superconductivity in bilayer and trilayer nickelates has spurred intense interest in the Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates; yet the fundamental properties of the NiO2 layer remain obscured by interlayer coupling. It is therefore imperative to investigate the electronic properties of their single-layer counterpart to isolate the intrinsic physics of the NiO layer. In this work, we present a systematic study of the single-layer nickelate La1.4Sr0.6NiO4 using high-resolution angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) and theoretical calculations. We reveal strong electron correlation effects, manifested by high-energy kinks in band dispersions and a pronounced orbital-dependent band renormalization. Interestingly, we observe a quasi-one-dimensional electronic structure characterized by straight Fermi surface sheets along the diagonal momentum directions. Such square Fermi surface topology facilitates non-Fermi liquid behavior consistent with the Luttinger liquid model, as evidenced by the power-law spectral function, robust temperature scaling, and the observation of spin-charge separation. Our results therefore not only unveil an exotic Luttinger liquid behavior emerging from the unexpected dimensional reduction in an intrinsically quasi-two-dimensional nickelate but also provide a new perspective for understanding the intriguing physics in multilayer nickelates.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该工作通过高分辨角分辨光电子能谱与理论计算研究单层镍酸盐 La1.4Sr0.6NiO4，报道了轨道依赖的能带重整化、准一维费米面以及符合 Luttinger 液体模型的非费米液体行为（幂律谱函数、温度标度、自旋-电荷分离），与凝聚态全息/强关联非费米液体主题相关，实验与理论结合较为扎实，故建议点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 单层镍酸盐 La1.4Sr0.6NiO4 中的 Luttinger 液体行为
decision.abstract_zh: 双层和三层镍酸盐中高温超导的发现激发了人们对 Ruddlesden-Popper 镍酸盐的强烈兴趣；然而 NiO2 层的基本性质仍被层间耦合所掩盖。因此，研究其单层对应物的电子性质以隔离 NiO 层的内禀物理变得十分必要。在本工作中，我们使用高分辨角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）和理论计算对单层镍酸盐 La1.4Sr0.6NiO4 进行了系统研究。我们揭示了强电子关联效应，表现为能带色散中的高能扭折以及显著的轨道依赖能带重整化。有趣的是，我们观察到一种准一维电子结构，其特征是沿对角动量方向的直线费米面片。这种方形费米面拓扑促进了与 Luttinger 液体模型一致的非费米液体行为，这由幂律谱函数、稳健的温度标度以及自旋-电荷分离的观测所证明。因此，我们的结果不仅揭示了一种源于本征准二维镍酸盐中意外维度约化的奇异 Luttinger 液体行为，而且为理解多层镍酸盐中有趣的物理提供了新视角。
